Peter walked on water. Then he looked at the wind. 🌊 Matthew 14:22-33

Middle of the night, middle of a storm, and Jesus comes walking on the sea. “Be of good cheer; it is I; be not afraid” (Matthew 14:27). Peter steps out, sees the wind, starts to sink, and cries “Lord, save me.” Jesus doesn't wait: “immediately Jesus stretched forth his hand, and caught him” (Matthew 14:31).

What's the “wind” you keep staring at right now? 👇

The strongest man alive told the wrong person his secret. 💇‍♂️ Judges 16

Delilah asked three times. Samson lied three times. Then he told her everything, and “he wist not that the Lord was departed from him” (Judges 16:20). Blinded, chained, grinding in a prison. But his hair began to grow again, and his last prayer was “O Lord God, remember me, I pray thee, and strengthen me, I pray thee, only this once” (Judges 16:28).

Have you ever prayed a “Lord, remember me” prayer? 👇

Lock in for finals. But not without Him. 🖤📖

4 reminders for finals season: study hard, then actually sleep. Pray before you panic. Give it your best and leave the rest to Him. And on your study break, read one chapter. “Be careful for nothing; but in every thing by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving let your requests be made known unto God” (Philippians 4:6).

Which one do you need this finals week? Comment 1 to 4 👇

They told him to be quiet. He got louder. 📢 Mark 10:46-52

A blind man begging by the road outside Jericho hears Jesus is passing by. The crowd tells him to hush. “But he cried the more a great deal, Thou Son of David, have mercy on me” (Mark 10:48). Jesus stood still. “Go thy way; thy faith hath made thee whole” (Mark 10:52).

What's the prayer you refuse to stop praying? 👇

She could have gone home. She stayed. 🌾 Ruth 1-4

Ruth lost her husband in Moab, and her mother-in-law Naomi told her to go back to her family. Instead: “whither thou goest, I will go; and where thou lodgest, I will lodge: thy people shall be my people, and thy God my God” (Ruth 1:16). She gleaned barley in a field that just happened to belong to Boaz. Her son Obed “is the father of Jesse, the father of David” (Ruth 4:17).

Who's your Naomi? Tag them 👇
